qualifications.description: Qualifications every delivered record shares, stated once here and omitted from the records (selection protocol v3). Under v3 a record belongs to the selection with its request_id, request_item_id and, when the record states one, requested_dataset.

has_more.description: Whether later pages of this selection remain in the stored result (selection protocol v2).

loader.description: The loader every delivered record of this selection shares, omitted from those records (selection protocol v3).

page.description: Delivered page number of this selection (selection protocol v2).

qualifications.description: Qualifications every delivered record of this selection shares, stated once here and omitted from its records (selection protocol v3). A record's qualifications are its own, this selection's and the response's.

source_search_completeness.description: The provider-search completeness every delivered record of this selection shares, omitted from those records (selection protocol v3).

vendor.description: The vendor every delivered record of this selection shares, omitted from those records (selection protocol v3).

include_overview.description: Include Backend-owned planner guidance. Set false for a compact UI directory; overview is then empty. Detailed source entries and saved metadata retain their separate selection controls.

include_summaries.description: Include compact structured summaries of built-in dataset constructors. Uses source_ids when supplied; otherwise includes the complete directory. Does not load observations or establish account access or coverage.

categories.description: Native categories sharing fields, selectors and requested_window. Use separate groups when settings differ. Each category retains its compatibility checks and attribution; expanded dataset limit is 64.

category.description: One native category. Supply category or nonempty categories, never both.

datasets.description: Native dataset needs applied to every subject in this request. Choose categories compatible with the subject kind and vendor in the dataset directory. Split independent subject/product needs into separate requests. Omit or pass [] when only resolving identity. A macro_concept with no datasets searches Macrobond series, Trading Economics indicators and the Trading Economics markets catalog (indices, FX, commodities, bond yields).

page_size.description: Ranked identities delivered per subject and dataset in the first page, 1..25 (default 10). Raise it only when the default page lacks the requested measurement. The complete pool is stored either way; later pages use the request's page field.

asset_id.description: Native catalogue asset_id copied from a returned asset identity, with its single ticker. A returned FX or crypto ticker such as BTC-USD also resolves without it.

ticker.description: One asset ticker. Supply ticker or nonempty tickers, never both.

tickers.description: Asset tickers sharing asset_type; supply instead of ticker. Order and per-asset attribution are preserved. Expanded subject limit is 256.

concept.description: Complete economic measurement intent used for relevance ranking, including meaningful level/growth, real/nominal, frequency and unit distinctions. This subject supports Macrobond and Trading Economics categories, not instrument DailyBars/MinuteBars. Use asset/symbol/asset_name for instrument products. This text is also used for provider retrieval when keywords is omitted.

geographies.description: Common country ISO2 codes or unique exact source-catalog country names, ASCII-case-insensitive with outer ASCII whitespace ignored. Japan and JP select the same country. Ambiguous names or native-only codes require explicit native facets; EU and EA do not have the same meaning across vendors. Omit or pass [] for unscoped search. Source definitions, coverage and access remain independent facts.

keywords.description: Optional short provider retrieval terms. These replace concept only for literal provider text search; relevance ranking still uses the full concept. Trading Economics catalog discovery retains the candidate catalog for semantic ranking. Keep separate analysis requirements and native facets out of this literal query.

providers.description: Macro providers to search: TradingEconomics and/or Macrobond. Omit or pass [] to search every macro catalog together. Naming Macrobond also excludes series the current subscription cannot load, listed in one explicit row. A dataset category or native facet for an excluded provider is a request-shape error.

region.description: Explicit Macrobond-native Region value or unique declared compact-catalog name. Countries, aggregates, historical and opaque geography-entity values keep their native meaning; eu is Euro Area and wq is World (51 Countries). This axis is not a shared ISO2 country code. When no common country is supplied, omission leaves Macrobond search unrestricted.

category_group.description: Optional Trading Economics category group narrowing that vendor's search. Markets searches only the markets catalog (indices, FX, commodities, bond yields); another group, such as Prices or Labour, searches only indicators in that group. Omit to search both Trading Economics catalogs.

country.description: Optional explicit Trading Economics-native country or aggregate code/name, resolved by its source vocabulary. WL/World, EA/Euro area and EU/European Union remain distinct; no country or proxy is guessed when omitted. A conflicting common country filter is a request-shape error.

candidate_limit.description: Optional company identity candidate limit. Vendor limits remain explicit; macro retrieval uses its native source limits independently. This does not limit the saved collected pool or the separate model-facing preview.

page.description: Read a later page of one returned selection instead of searching. Supply requests: [] and no other options. Nothing is refetched or re-ranked.
Page number, 2 or later; the search response delivered page 1 with the request's page_size.

request_item_id.description: selections[].request_item_id of the selection to continue.

requested_dataset.description: selections[].requested_dataset of that selection, copied exactly; omit when it has none.

result_ref.description: receipt.result_ref from the search response being continued.

query_ref.description: Opaque owner-scoped receipt for the exact delivered request and output page. It is comparison evidence, not a loader binding or retained source pool.

retained_in_handoff.description: Current retained authority for this replayed query proof. Original result refs, receipts, expiry, total_stored, has_more and next_cursor are archival query facts; they are not live paging handles or an active retained source pool.
